svg.aria-label: Affine quantization of five values onto 16 integer codes: real values on the top line, codes on the bottom line
svg.title: Affine quantization of five values onto 16 integer codes: real values on the top line, codes on the bottom line

text.tspan: zero is exact: 0.0 becomes code 6, and back to 0.0
scale s = (2.3 - (-1.5)) / 15 = 0.2533 zero-point z = 6 code = round(x / s) + z
